title: How the Zavient AI-work site turns data into leads
intro: Where the data comes from, how it becomes pages, and how a visitor becomes a lead. Press Play, or step through it.
source: Proposed design, 25 Nov 2026, from the site plan in docs/zavient-ai-site-master-plan.md. Sources named are real; sample items are invented and labelled.

buyer.label: Company buyer
buyer.sub: e.g. a claims VP at an insurer
buyer.info: Someone at a company deciding how to use AI for one job. Finds us from Google or an AI answer.

russell.label: Russell
russell.info: Gets every lead with the context: company, job, industry, what they read.

site.label: zavient.com pages
site.info: About 2,500 pages: 20 AI jobs, 14 industries, about 20 job-by-industry pairs, model and comparison pages. Every page carries the offer.

offer.label: Benchmark offer
offer.info: The form on every page: benchmark AI models on your own documents, then build what wins.

db.label: AI-work database
db.info: One data file. Each job has its best models, scores with sources, cost per task, tools and open data sets.

runner.label: Benchmark runner
runner.info: Runs a question set across 20 models, grades against a hand-checked answer key, records cost per correct answer.

public.label: Public benchmarks
public.info: Published scores, each mapped to the job it measures. Cited, never copied where the license forbids.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.info: Public model list and prices, and the paid API we run benchmarks through.

news.label: News feeds
news.info: New model releases and company AI rollouts. Each becomes its own page within a day, reusing the Zarlent new-deal page engine.

steps.text: Pull public scores and map each to a job. LegalBench feeds contract review; tau-bench feeds customer-service agents.
Pull every model with its price and hosts.
Catch news: a new model or a company AI rollout.
Run our own benchmark: 30 finance questions to 20 models.
Save scores: right answers and cost per correct answer.
Build the pages from the database.
A buyer searches Google for 'insurance underwriting ai' and lands on our page.
The page shows best models for the job, cost per task, tools and our benchmark.
The buyer fills in the offer form at the end of the page.
The lead lands with Russell, with what the buyer read.
Paid benchmark: the buyer's sample documents go to the runner.
The runner tests 20 models on the buyer's documents.
steps.ifNot: Sensitive files run on a private host instead of OpenRouter.

steps.text: The report shows which model wins and what it costs. Next sale: build it.
A practitioner reports what worked for them.
Check it, then add it to the job's page as a practitioner report.
steps.ifNot: Reports without a job, model and result are not published.
